steps.title: Analyze audio focus conflict causing playback termination
steps.description: Identified that requesting audio focus from BackgroundAudioService stole focus from WebView internal audio player, triggering automatic video pause.

steps.title: Fix Audio Focus self-preemption loop in BackgroundAudioService
steps.description: Refactored audio focus handling so BackgroundAudioService updates MediaSession and WakeLock without taking focus away from WebView audio output.

steps.title: Enhance HTML5 Page Visibility API and event overrides in WebView
steps.description: Injected Javascript overrides for document.hidden, visibilityState, document.hasFocus, and event propagation to prevent YouTube player from auto-pausing.

steps.title: Strengthen notification and background state persistence
steps.description: Updated foreground notification pending intents and media metadata update cycle for continuous background audio.
